stages.label: Cargo booked
stages.narrative: Modeled cargo, vessel, route intent, and custody establish the selected voyage.

stages.label: Vessel underway
stages.narrative: The vessel advances through governed corridors while speed changes time and fuel use.

stages.label: Port operations
stages.narrative: Chokepoints, weather scenarios, queue arrivals, and berth service alter the voyage.

stages.label: Cargo delivered
stages.narrative: Custody, transit, queue distribution, and emissions sensitivity settle independently.

seeds.description: Asia–Europe baseline via Malacca, Bab-el-Mandeb, and Suez.

seeds.label: Suez closure

seeds.label: North Atlantic cyclone
seeds.description: Rotterdam to New York/New Jersey with a synthetic North Atlantic cyclone disruption shaped to IBTrACS climatology.

seeds.label: Panama Canal restriction
